lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: This is it, Chief. The Master Zine is printed and ready. The fate of The Paragon rests on what's inside this folder.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: After all the editing, formatting, and late nights... it all comes down to this. I'm taking this straight to Mr. Reyes in the Admin Office.

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Good luck, Kiko! Don't let him intimidate you—our layout is solid and follows every rule!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Hurry over to the Admin Office before the morning submission window closes!

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Go make us proud at the Admin Office!
